thought_process.interpretation: The user wants a highly polished, functional, and interactive Bike Rental Dashboard (v3). Based on this, I will design a 'Process Monitor' and 'Executive Summary' hybrid dashboard for a city bike-sharing program. The dashboard will allow operations managers to monitor live metrics (Active Bikes, Revenue, Trips, Station Occupancy), analyze usage trends, and manage station statuses. I will implement fully working filters (timeframe, weather, search, and status toggles) that dynamically update all dashboard metrics, charts, and table rows. I will also include a fully functional CSV exporter for station data and an interactive station details modal.
assumed_from_scratch: Interactive SVG Station Map representing coordinate-based layouts
State-driven data generator reacting to multiple filters
thought_process.skill_suggestions: Add a predictive demand forecasting chart using historical weather patterns to help operations teams preemptively balance station inventory.
